title: Printable flyer, menu or invoice page
when: The user wants a page meant to be printed or saved as PDF: a flyer, menu, certificate or invoice.
prompt:
Goal: A page that looks right on screen and prints exactly on the chosen paper size.
Steps:
1. Set @page size (A4 or Letter) and margins; design to that width in mm or cm.
2. Use print safe colors and black text; check that backgrounds are not required for meaning.
3. Avoid breaks inside items with break-inside: avoid; force breaks between pages where needed.
4. Hide screen only controls in @media print and show a Print button on screen.
5. Totals and numbers aligned with tabular figures.
Quality bar:
- Prints on the intended number of pages.
- Readable at arm length.
- No cut text at the edges.
Pitfalls:
- Relying on background colors that browsers skip in print.
- Viewport units in print.
- Huge images that slow printing.
Verify:
- [ ] @media print and @page rules exist.
- [ ] Print button is a button.
- [ ] Contrast passes.
- [ ] Viewport present.
Output: One HTML file with its print stylesheet.

examples.output: @page A4, two column menu, prices aligned, print button hidden in print
